Card Q&A.a: It refers to when the memory gauge is at 4 or further to the right on your side.
Card Q&A.q: What position on the memory gauge does "while you have 4 or less memory" refer to?
At the start of my turn, this card's [Start of Your Turn] effect plays a card. Can I then activate the [Start of Your Turn] effect on the played card?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 4 or less memory, by returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Hiroko Sagisaka] or 1 [TS] trait Digimon card with 5000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
